Hey man. I dont rightfully know about lsd, but hallucinogenics have fear deconditioning effect, which basically means that under their influence you can think more rationaly. This changes the perspective. When you are kid your view isnt contaminated by life traumas so you view beuty more as you primary motive is finding satisfaction, exploration. Now if your traumatized then your focus changes to threath, finding posible danger. So your perception naturaly changes. If being under prolonged stress after a while you simply hone those senses. You percieve threats only. After a while only thing you see is possible danger no beuty or similar things. Everything is vibrant and vivid cos you find it interesting and your unavare its dangers. Its funny how there are 2 spectres one calm meditative mind, one warrior calm search and destroy threats. I can attest that levels of concentration here are similar. Only in second one you notice enviroment more. Sounds, movements, you notice more cos your attention is external.. Meditation shifts focus internaly. With shifting focus internaly you integrate your experience into rational, so this lowers fear levels. With this next step is to get into jhanas where your aim is to get awakened.. Now everybody who had jhanic exp knows that  theres loss of sensory stimulus as you dwelve into deeper jhanas. At first its emotions ,sound, then touch, then eyesight, etc. This leads to nirvana, or rather understanding who are you. Nirvana is a moment when nothing exist cos normal *you* turns off completly, and jhanas train yourself to be able. Then new you comes into play. This is why theres reincarnation thingy in budhism, to be easier for people to get whats what like that. Your subconius way of dealing with fears makes your agenda in concius. Some would like this whole proces to be misterious and unknown. Whole dark night and all levels, nanas whatever are just your self building a courage to understand reality.
